title: Lemma Pro Benchmark v1
description: Category benchmark comparing a target to documented, consented aggregates only. No per-tenant data is included. Aggregated inputs (documented): category-level aggregate records containing only pre-aggregated counts/rates/scores (sample_size, mean_score, p50_score, p90_score, metric rates) and metadata (benchmark_version, category, last_updated_at, source). Target ranking: deterministic percentile/rank computed against aggregate distribution bands (p50/p90 and mean) from the provided aggregate; if sample_size is below minimum or required aggregate fields are missing, status is insufficient_sample and no extrapolation is performed. Changing aggregation/ranking semantics requires a new schema version.
